note: Vendored, sha-pinned upstream model definition for the synthdetect eval runtime (issue #144, M1 S2b). The default candidate detector w2v2-aasist is the community reference SSL_Anti-spoofing model (wav2vec2-XLS-R front end + AASIST back end). Its Python class definitions are not a pip package, so tools/synthdetect_infer.py loads them from this verbatim copy. Byte-identity to the pinned upstream commit is the integrity check: the sha256 below must equal the upstream file, and a contract test binds both to tools/synthdetect_sources.py MODELS['w2v2-aasist'].commit and services/synthdetect/provenance.eval.json model_repo.commit.

ssl_antispoofing_model.py.modifications: none (verbatim). The upstream SSLModel hard-codes the relative XLS-R checkpoint path 'xlsr2_300m.pt'; the eval adapter resolves it by constructing the model with the mounted weights directory as the working directory, so this file is never edited and its hash stays meaningful.
ssl_antispoofing_model.py.loaded_by: tools/synthdetect_infer.py:_load_real_engine (importlib spec_from_file_location; imports fairseq + torch, available only inside services/synthdetect/Dockerfile.eval)
